scope.description: P6 phase-one implementation: an independently linked fail-closed artifact validator, executable-level fault injection, and a filesystem-backed run-root transaction with exclusive staging, same-device atomic freeze, parent fsync and crash-after-rename recovery. Dataset-gate, HTML, runtime collection and scientific kernels are out of scope.

assumptions: The current catalog, schema registry, producer receipt, checksum, index and semantic-digest contracts are read-only authorities for this subtask.
Any contract detail that cannot be proven from the current schema fails closed and is reported rather than patched through catalog or registry files.
Passing this bounded P6 implementation does not make the pipeline production ready.

inputs.path: docs/audits/20260720_HCC1395完整執行與全資料推進閘門稽核_01.json

step_verify.step: Lock the exact write set and check all active task leases before implementation.
step_verify.verify: longlineage-governance check-state exits 0 and reports non-overlapping write sets.

step_verify.step: Implement the independent validator library and CLI without producer-kernel linkage.
step_verify.verify: The executable-level validator fault table catches missing, extra, truncated, hash, order, duplicate-key, forged-receipt, truth-field and incomplete-topology-winner cases; link inspection contains no longlineage_core.
Unit tests cover exclusive staging, same-device rejection, atomic directory rename, parent fsync, final-root invisibility without run_receipt and crash-after-rename recovery.
Debug build, targeted CTest, full CTest, source-boundary and governance checks exit 0; unresolved contract gaps remain fail-closed and are reported.

evidence.output_excerpt: 100% tests passed, 0 tests failed out of 2; validator executable fault table covers one positive control and nine fail-closed fault cases.
BOUNDARY RESULT: PASS validator_link=independent python_science=absent; validator link.txt contains no liblonglineage_core.

deviations: The synthetic valid BGZF fixture originally used pre-flush writer offsets for the final logical row. It was corrected to reopen the finalized BGZF and record reader-observable virtual offsets, matching the index replay contract.

governance/gate_registry.tsv already registered VALIDATOR_FAULT_INJECTION as ctest -R validator_fault and scripts/ci/check_source_boundaries.sh already enforced compiled validator link and source boundaries, so neither authority file required modification.
CMakeLists.txt and tests/CMakeLists.txt were released from this task write set after the validator and both P6 tests built and passed, allowing parent integration to proceed.
Phase one deliberately does not implement LLM_BGZF semantic replay; encountering that format returns LLM_REPLAY_UNIMPLEMENTED and cannot produce a production-ready validation claim.

On 2026-07-20 the successor full-validator task intentionally extended tests/integration/test_validator_fault.cpp. The phase-one evidence was therefore rebound to oracle/frozen_vectors/p6_validator_first_stage_receipt.txt, which records the original command, exit code, output excerpt and then-current source SHA without claiming full P6 or production readiness.

The publication repair replaced the presentation-boundary grep with an AST import/process-invocation scan so defensive forbidden-module literals no longer create false positives. The current evidence SHA binds that stricter scanner; the independent-validator boundary verdict remains unchanged and was replayed after the edit.
